name: scholarsphere
description: ScholarSphere - Smart Scholarship, Attendance, Documents & Student Success Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:student: concurrently -n "BACKEND,STUDENT:5173" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev:backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:student"
scripts.dev:teacher: concurrently -n "BACKEND,TEACHER:5174" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:teacher"
scripts.dev:admin: concurrently -n "BACKEND,ADMIN:5175" -c "blue,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:portals: concurrently -n "STUDENT:5173,TEACHER:5174,ADMIN:5175" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:student" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:teacher" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,STUDENT:5173,TEACHER:5174,ADMIN:5175" -c "blue,cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:student" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:teacher" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:admin"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,STUDENT:5173,TEACHER:5174,ADMIN:5175" -c "blue,cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:student" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:teacher" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:admin"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build

author: ScholarSphere Team
